name: Conversion Kit (Assault / Carbine / DMR / PDW / Payload / Ramjet / Rifle / SBR)

description.value:
Changes the gun's range table, opens it to attachments for its new class, and makes it two-handed and unconcealable. Damage, Autofire, capacity and everything else stay; no Range Table Modifications while it's in. Assault (sniper rifles, 500eb): Scout → Battle Rifle, Sniper → Assault Rifle, Anti-materiel → Marksman. DMR (Very Heavy Pistols, assault rifles, 750eb; fired with Shoulder Arms): pistols and Carbine → Scout, Assault/Battle → Sniper, Marksman → Anti-materiel. Carbine (Very Heavy Pistols, SMGs, 600eb): pistols and Subcompact → Carbine, SMG → Assault Rifle. Payload (launchers, 1,000eb; −1d6, 6×6m blasts, a Silencer hides only the launch): Grenade → Scout, Rocket → Sniper, Missile → Anti-materiel. PDW (pistols, 600eb): Snubnose → Subcompact, Pistol → SMG, Long Barrel → Carbine. Ramjet (bows, 1,000eb): Shortbow → Long Barrel Shotgun, Bow → Assault Rifle, Longbow → Scout. Rifle (Very Heavy Pistols, SMGs, 750eb; fired with Shoulder Arms): Snubnose, Pistol and Subcompact → Assault Rifle, Long Barrel and SMG → Battle Rifle. SBR (rifles, 1,000eb; −1d6 Single Shot to a 4d6 minimum, Autofire −1 to a 3 minimum): Carbine → Snubnose, Assault → Subcompact, Battle → SMG, Marksman/Scout → Long Barrel Pistol, Sniper/Anti-materiel → Carbine.

Cost: Varies
Fits: All Ranged Weapons, individual eligibility by weapon category
